frames.operation: The same voice is heard while speaking and on a recording. Establish the listener and question.
Reveal two routes converging on one hearing destination. Routes are conceptual, not a physical anatomy trace.
Keep the routes recognizable; add the microphone as a branch from airborne sound. The body route continues while speaking.
Switch the source to playback. The original internal route stops before the hearing destination; its faint trace preserves the comparison.
Equal-scale listener images and aligned route rows show what persists and what is absent. No invented amplitude or pitch data.

sequence_invariant: AIR yellow; BODY coral; same listening subject; hearing endpoint common in states 2–4
